items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes the inclusion of one topology in another by the inclusion of the corresponding categories of sheaves in the reverse direction (statement lines 11978-11983). The proof is a complete argument: one direction is immediate (proof line 11986); from the inclusion of the categories of sheaves the author obtains a canonical comparison between the two sheafification functors and identifies the second as the sheafification of the first (proof lines 11987-11999); and applying this to the sieve generated by a covering, together with the criterion characterizing covering sieves by sheafification, shows that such a sieve is covering for the larger topology (proof lines 12000-12018). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two sheafifications. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
